description:
## Goal

Port the fixed jido_action release/v3 Flow authoring corpus into the consolidated required authoring gate.

Plan: `docs/plans/2026-11-04-1255-test-flow-authoring-suite-plan.md`

## Scope

- Adapt 11 source test files, nine support assets, and one README from commit `177e7a4ce4342a9a6b7bc668f540dafbd7169d54`.
- Record `guides_test.exs` as superseded by named current guide and example evidence.
- Use current Catalog, stored Flow version 2, Joi, error, component, and JSON contracts.

## Non-goals

- Do not change `lib/**` or `refs/**`.
- Do not restore removed Registry, stored version 1, error, or guide contracts.
- Do not add general runtime, load, or duplicate guide coverage.

## Definition of done

- All 22 source assets have an exact target or superseded disposition.
- Flow and Agent authoring tests pass together through `mix test.authoring`.
- Source-manifest, offline CI, coverage, and quality-report checks pass on the clean integrated revision.
- Every child task is committed, closed, and integrated in dependency order.

comments.text: Completed in four dependency-ordered local commits ending at d620b31. All child tasks are closed and integrated. The fixed release/v3 corpus is fully accounted for, complete authoring and offline CI pass, clean coverage is 93.1726%, and the clean quality report has no findings or waivers.
